targetText: In brief, dialectics can be defined as the doctrine of the unity of opposites. This embodies the essence of dialectics, but it requires explanations and development.
explanation: Lenin's famous core definition of dialectics: reality develops not through external mechanistic pushes, but through the internal contradictory forces inherent in every phenomenon.

targetText: 1) The objectivity of consideration (not examples, not divergencies, but the Thing-in-itself).
explanation: Dialectics begins with objective materialist rigor: analyzing the object in its own internal properties and lawful motion, rather than selecting subjective or superficial illustrations.

targetText: 5) The thing (phenomenon, etc.) as the sum and unity of opposites.
explanation: Every material process is an internal unity of mutually conditioning and mutually exclusive tendencies that constitute its identity and drive its change.

targetText: 11) The endless process of the deepening of man's knowledge of the thing, of phenomena, processes, etc., from appearance to essence and from less profound to more profound essence.
explanation: Lenin outlines the dialectical materialist theory of reflection: human cognition is an infinite historical process penetrating deeper beyond superficial appearances into the essential lawful contradictions of nature and society.
